title: Smoking and the gift of Camels
summary: Cleared by his mother to smoke at Blair, his grandfather gave him a cigarette case and Camels; he talks about trying to quit.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: Well, like I said before, he didn't exactly encourage it, but he didn't really discourage it. I remember the first time they caught me smoking, and oh, I was going to Blair Academy, I think. I was 15 then. And they said -- they had a smoking room there. All the kids had been getting caught smoking, you know, and finally the headmaster said, "I'm going to establish a smoking room and those who can get permission from their parents will be allowed to use it." So everybody else wrote, and I called up my mother and I said, "Look, you don't want me to be caught out behind the gymnasium smoking a cigarette, because I'm going to do it. Why don't you wire permission for me to smoke" which she did, and here I am, all the seniors and everything there, they hadn't got their permission, I'm the only one in the smoking room. I'm sitting in there, lighting it up. But my grandfather, I'll never forget, he said, "If you're going to smoke," this was when I got home, he said, "Now, if you're going to smoke," he said, "I want you to smoke a good cigarette," and he gave me a cigarette case and a package of Camels.
And how long did you smoke Camels?
And now you're using filters, right?
Oh, I'm down to the lowest tar that you can find, the lowest -- you hear so much it scares you to
death, but I can't quite. I've tried it -- I quit for five months twice, but something happens and all of a sudden you light one up and you're gone again.

Oh, they were strong. After you smoke these filters and somebody comes up with one of those -- well, they don't make those anymore, I don't think, the old type Camels. You'd inhale that and the whole room would start spinning, you know.
